name: Dhiraj Kavuri
hero: Dhiraj Kavuri is one who builds AI that stops and asks.
intro: I study data science at Simon Fraser University and build AI products for clients in the US. This year I shipped 30+ products at hackathons, on my own, and won prizes at 5 of them: 1st at IIT Mandi and Banana Hacks, 2nd at CreateOS × Stripe and VelesHack, 3rd at Qollab × IonQ.
howto: Each product below has one rule its AI can't get around. Open one to see the question I'd expect you to ask, my answer, and the lines of code that enforce the rule.
featuredHeading: What the AI doesn't get to decide
restHeading: Everything else I shipped this year
restIntro: One line each. Open any of them to try it, read the code or watch the demo.

outside.title: Client work
outside.text: Since August 2023 I've built AI agents, LLM features and full-stack web apps for clients in the US. For one finance client I automated quarterly investor reporting: one click exports 40+ formatted PDFs per workbook across 18+ investor accounts, and it saves 6+ hours every reporting cycle.

outside.title: Sonrise
outside.text: An iPhone app I designed and built in SwiftUI, on the App Store with a subscription. It's an alarm that keeps ringing until you finish a small task.

outside.title: Concord, published
outside.text: Concord's image model and dataset are on Hugging Face with DOIs, and its technical report is on Zenodo.
